game.name: Final Fantasy IV 3D Remake
game.desc: The 2007 Nintendo DS 3D remake of Final Fantasy IV, running natively on handheld Linux. The port replaces the Android runtime with a native one, built from its own ELF loader, a JNI bridge, an ARC1 virtual file system for the encrypted OBB, OpenSL ES over SDL audio, and GLES1 resolved at run time.
